summary.text: Rick Girdler is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 15, serving since 2017. The legislature's profile lists Girdler as vice chair of the Senate Banking & Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Rick Girdler was born on May 23, 1955, and is a self-employed insurance agent.
The profile lists attendance at Cumberland College after Pulaski County High School, and a Shelter Insurance Hall of Fame recognition.
It also lists service on the Northern School site-based council and as a board member and coach for Somerset Little League and Babe Ruth baseball.
